source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB three-policy matrix; adjacent interval case is a copied-body conflict and not equivalent.

source_snapshot.procedure: Set 0x00/0x06 values 00/01/02, read 0x00/0x01, cold-reset BMC, remove/restore AC from on/off states.
source_snapshot.criteria: Policy bits and physical restore behavior match off/last/on matrix.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; high-level chassis policy; warns power state.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Names correct feature but omits per-policy AC matrix and recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires one approved policy per run, reset/reconnect, controlled AC, observers and restore.
historical_reviews.history: IB analogue is separate; adjacent interval title cannot reuse this body.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No reset or AC action is authorized by Review.

original_test_intent: Validate all supported AC-restore policy values through readback, BMC reset persistence and their distinct physical outcomes after controlled AC loss/return.
original_method: Set raw 0x00/0x06, read chassis status policy bits, cold-reset BMC, then physically cycle AC from defined host states.
manual_activity: Owner approves each policy trial, host starting state, AC fixture/window and independent console/recovery.
safety_requirements: One policy/state trial at a time
agent_execution_scope: Cold-reset and reconnect only when authorized
engineer_actions: Judge host health and DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: High-level policy may set/read the value but does not prove reset persistence or physical AC-return behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected raw or approved equivalent for one policy, verify bits across BMC reset, then run one separately authorized AC-state trial.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Three values, on/off preconditions, reset, AC sequence, Script and timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute the off, last-state-on, last-state-off and on outcomes as separate approved trials with readback, recovery and final baseline restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds controlled fixture, per-trial approval and objective boot/power recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Policy readback alone does not prove AC-return behavior; one policy cannot stand for the matrix.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: AC loss can corrupt workload state or affect neighboring equipment if topology is wrong.

project_override_considerations: A BMC UI/Redfish/vendor tool may replace the setter only with equivalent value/readback/persistence coverage; physical AC-return behavior remains required.
expected_evidence: AC removal/return and physical power/boot evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, standard values, readback and behavior criteria form a coherent three-policy test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Risky actions are well defined; target topology, approval and recovery are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Separates the destructive matrix into bounded trials and prevents readback-only coverage from replacing physical AC behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: Last-state policy has two required initial-state branches, unlike always-off/on. Therefore the behavioral matrix has four distinct outcomes; each must bind the captured pre-loss host state to post-return power and boot evidence, with policy persistence checked independently of the physical result.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code, policy, IB and adjacent interval search
